answer: The tide test I would run is Proof of unique import licence with trade ministry attestation: a licence the ministry renews after compliance audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a licence the ministry renews after compliance audits stays private; the inlet is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the relic of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
